name: open-computer-use
description: Open-source cross-platform Computer Use MCP server packaged as a Codex plugin (AntonKhakhalin fork of opensymph/open-computer-use, with native macOS window management in this fork).

interface.shortDescription: Control desktop apps from Codex with the open local server
interface.longDescription: Open Computer Use packages this repository's open-source desktop automation server as a Codex plugin. It is a fork of opensymph/open-computer-use: in addition to the upstream nine desktop-control MCP tools (accessibility-first, background-first), this fork adds native macOS window management (list_windows, get_window, get_window_state, launch_app, activate_window, window-targeted actions). It exposes the tools through a local macOS app bundle or Linux / Windows native binary, with semantic accessibility paths preferred before fallback input.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state of this desktop app without stealing focus when possible
List the open windows of an app and read one specific window by its id
Open a new local document with keyboard shortcuts first, then type content without moving my real pointer unless required
Drive the fixture app and verify the computer-use tools still behave correctly
